summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Thesis Export with Multiple Methods Selection feature. All backend APIs and frontend UI elements working correctly. The feature allows users to select multiple statistical methods (counting, mnl, linear_regression, mixed_logit, hierarchical_bayes) and multiple chapters (3, 4, 5) for thesis export.
critical_code_review_comments: Cache key format correctly implemented: thesis_{sorted_methods_joined}_{sorted_chapters_joined} (e.g., thesis_counting_mnl_3_4_5)
Methods are sorted alphabetically in cache key ensuring same methods in different order produce same cache key
All 5 statistical methods supported: counting, mnl, linear_regression, mixed_logit, hierarchical_bayes
Chapter selection working correctly with dynamic button text showing method and chapter count
Minimum 1 method validation works - can't uncheck the last selected method
Hint text changes when multiple methods selected to mention comparison in Chapter 4
Backend always adds 'counting' as baseline method when computing results for thesis generation
seed_data_creation: Used existing study ID: 38d01d61-385e-45af-8417-93c67994db59 (ข้าว, 51 responses) with cached thesis results
context_for_next_testing_agent: Multi-method thesis export feature fully tested. Backend endpoints: POST /export-thesis (accepts {methods: [...], chapters: [...]}), GET /export-thesis-status/{job_id}, GET /export-thesis-download?cache_key=X. Frontend modal has data-testid attributes: thesis-method-counting, thesis-method-mnl, thesis-method-linear_regression, thesis-method-mixed_logit, thesis-method-hierarchical_bayes, thesis-chapter-3/4/5, thesis-confirm-export-btn. Cache keys format: thesis_{sorted_methods}_{sorted_chapters}. Note: AI budget may be exceeded causing 502 errors for new thesis generation - cached results work fine.
